title: The mailbox, 2024
logline: The mailbox in December, flag down, and a footprint in the mud in front of it — someone checked. The page doesn't say whose boot.

panels.composition: A roadside mailbox in December with its flag down and a single boot print in the mud in front of it, rain, the road empty.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a roadside mailbox in December with its flag down and a single boot print in the mud before it, rain and an empty road, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
